name: Ostřetín (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a blue band into a yellow upper fly part and a green lower hoist part, with a narrow blue stripe along the top.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 11 May 2001 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
